result: I replaced the static `/health` handler with a real database probe: `app/Http/Controllers/HealthController.ts` (new) runs `SELECT 1` through the app's actual Drizzle SQLite connection (`getDatabase()` from `config/database.ts`) on every request, returning `200 {"status":"ok","checks":{"db":{"status":"ok"}}}` on success or `503 {"status":"error","checks":{"db":{"status":"error","message":...}}}` if the query throws; `routes/web.ts` now wires `GET /health` to this controller instead of the inline handler (the route stays unnamed/unauthenticated, so the existing host-authorization exemption and Inertia exclusion in `src/app.ts` are untouched). Added `tests/controllers/HealthController.test.ts` asserting the 200 shape; `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, and `bunx guren check` all pass.
